api.tools.i6dmo.data.WindowSpec.from_design(: span_hours=24, spacing_hours=2, observations=13, include_origin=True, issuance_hours=1; offsets_hours() == (-24,-22,...,-2,0)
api.tools.i6dmo.data.load_input(input_dir, d: ts, x, price, features, file digests; refuses TEST rows, manifest mismatch, STLFSI4 or alias columns
api.tools.i6dmo.data.build_origin_table(bund: every observed hourly bar is an origin candidate (no thinning); per origin: row_id 'EURUSD|<iso t>', split (FIT|INNER|VALIDATION), week_id, input_ok + reason, per-head label mask (C1 MANAGEMENT M), per-head entry mask (C1 ENTRY M), p(t), p(t+h) exact or NaN; counted reasons per split x head
api.tools.i6dmo.data.materialize(bundle, tab: X float64 (n,13,19) RAW; y_price float64 (n,6) original price p(t+h) with NaN where mask False; mask bool (n,6); entry_mask bool (n,6); price_origin (n,); origin_ts (n,); row_ids (n,). Only rows with input_ok and >=1 valid head are included (keep_row_if_any_head_valid)
api.tools.i6dmo.data.fit_statistics(bundle,: per-feature mean/std over FIT-row window bars only; per-head fit-only naive MAE (loss scale) ; zero scale -> typed ZERO_SCALE disposition, never an epsilon
api.tools.i6dmo.data.verify_bundle(out_dir): re-hashes every file and row id list; typed BUNDLE_DIGEST_MISMATCH on any change
api.tools.i6dmo.naive.naive_replay(input_dir: independent of data.py target arrays: re-reads ts/price, looks up p(t) and p(t+h) by exact timestamp, returns per-head n, sum_abs, mae and row_ids_sha256
api.tools.i6dmo.naive.weekly_diagnostics(row: per week x head sums/counts, explicit ABSENT weeks/heads; annual pooled MAE = sum/count, never mean of weekly MAEs
api.tools.i6dmo.provenance.availability_gate: reuses tools.i6n_contracts.feature_availability.gate; returns PASS + unverified list; confirmatory_test_blocked=True while any feature is UNVERIFIED
api.tools.i6dmo.provenance.producer_status(): seven unresolved producers/clocks: RECOVERED (path@commit + reproduction match) or STILL_UNRESOLVED (missing object)
api.tools.i6dmo.data.load_split(bundle_dir,: verify then merge model and aux arrays
api.tools.i6dmo.data.build_frozen_bundle(inp: writes ARRAYS_<split>.npz for FIT/INNER/VALIDATION and BUNDLE.json with digests: input files, calendar, manifest, availability contract, gate report, row_ids per split, arrays, origin-table reason counts, coverage report; bundle_sha256 is the identity consumed by model/ops
api.tools.i6dmo.naive.paired_metrics(arrays,: builds the C2 (tools.i6n_contracts.paired_metrics) input on identical row ids and physical h, scores it, and attaches a manual recomputation that must agree; relative error (MAE_h-naive_h)/naive_h, negative better

fixed_decisions_implemented: origin t is the last completed observed hourly bar (bar-END clock); its value is included
inputs are 13 slot instants t-24h..t at 2 h spacing, each sampled as-of the last finite observation with available_time <= s (DS2_ASOF_LAST_AVAILABLE); staleness recorded; never the next row
targets p(t+h) at exact hourly endpoints h in {2,3,4,5,6,12}; never the next observed row
split membership: origin in split AND target in the same split (cross-boundary labels purged); FIT label_available_by = inner boundary
TRAIN [2020-01-01,2024-01-01); INNER = last 8 weeks (2023-11-06..2024-01-01); VALIDATION [2024-01-01,2025-01-01); TEST never materialized

bundle_format.conforms_to: INTERFACE_MODEL.json consumed_data_bundle_contract (model lane @12e13752); its load_data_bundle() accepted the real bundle

BUNDLE.json.splits: {fit, inner, validation} -> {path, sha256 (file), aux_path, start, end, label_available_by, n_rows, row_ids_sha256, arrays_sha256, aux_sha256 (content), head_valid, head_entry_valid, counts (typed reasons), first/last_origin}
BUNDLE.json.fit_statistics: per-head fit-only naive MAE (naive_mae_fit) and per-feature fit-only mean/std; status OK|ZERO_SCALE|UNSUPPORTED_HEAD
BUNDLE.json.other: inputs{name:sha256}, calendar{id,version,sha256,label ASSUMED_NOT_BROKER}, availability_gate, producer_status, confirmatory_test_blocked, coverage, design_sha256, code{commit, files_sha256}, bundle_sha256 (content identity; excludes npz container digests, which carry write times), files{name: file sha256}

bundle_format.<split>.npz: exactly row_id (n,) int64 origin epoch s, x (n,13,19) float64 RAW oldest->origin, origin_price (n,), target_price (n,6) NaN where mask False, mask (n,6) bool = C1 MANAGEMENT label support
bundle_format.<split>_aux.npz: row_id (n,) int64 (same order), row_ids (n,) str 'EURUSD|<iso>', entry_mask (n,6) bool = C1 ENTRY support (subset of mask), week_ids (n,) str calendar week; slot_staleness_s (n,13,19) int64
